'''2011 German National Championship Massimiliano Colussi DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Massimiliano Colussi]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Rambo Trooper
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
